request.text: Check whether it will rain in Hangzhou on Saturday afternoon for my picnic with Mei, and remind me Friday at 7 PM to message her about whether we should bring umbrellas.

responsibilities.outcome: Report whether rain is expected in Hangzhou on Saturday afternoon for the picnic with Mei.
Create a Friday 7 PM reminder to message Mei about whether to bring umbrellas.

bindings.reminder_subject: message Mei about whether we should bring umbrellas

new_goals.description: Obtain and report the Saturday-afternoon Hangzhou rain forecast for the picnic with Mei.
new_goals.source_text: Check whether it will rain in Hangzhou on Saturday afternoon for my picnic with Mei
constraints: Use Hangzhou as the forecast location.
Use Saturday afternoon as the forecast period.
success_criteria: The user receives a grounded rain forecast relevant to the picnic with Mei.

new_goals.description: Create a Friday 7 PM reminder to message Mei about whether to bring umbrellas.
new_goals.source_text: remind me Friday at 7 PM to message her about whether we should bring umbrellas
constraints: Schedule the reminder for Friday at 7 PM.
Preserve Mei and the umbrella question in the reminder subject.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and message topic.

semantic_facts: The plan must keep the Hangzhou forecast and Friday reminder as separate Goals.
Weather lookup owns the grounded answer and reminder creation owns the stateful effect; these independent steps need no artificial ordering.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents the forecast, claims the reminder succeeded without trusted evidence, or claims it messaged Mei.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The forecast and reminder are collapsed because both concern the same picnic conversation.
The Planner omits one Goal, serializes independent Capability work, or substitutes advice for reminder creation.
